description: mtk_uartboot: loads and starts a bootloader (BL2, then an FIP) over UART on MediaTek router SoCs (MT7622, MT7629, MT798x) with secure boot disabled, to recover a bricked device or RAM-boot U-Boot.
notes: Needs a 3.3 V USB-UART adapter on the board's serial console. Close any terminal (PuTTY, MobaXterm) on that
COM port first: mtk_uartboot needs the port for itself. Without -s it takes the first serial port it finds.
Example (MT798x, ARM64): mtk_uartboot -s COM6 --aarch64 -p bl2-ram.bin -f fip.bin
The RAM-boot BL2 and FIP come from the board vendor or OpenWrt, not with this tool.
If it hangs at 'BL2 UART DL version', add --bl2-load-baudrate 115200.
Does not work on SoCs with secure boot enabled. For MediaTek phones use MTKClient instead.
